cpu_allocation: Measured family CPU divided equally between seed receipts; individual task CPU retained.

decision.pass_bar: >= 95/100 orders end at the certified profile

null_summary.model: certified optimum reference, not a permutation-significance test

scope: Finite scoped evaluation; potential kappa levers are census targets only.

result.certification: Exact integer-surrogate optimum; rational interval bounds the true toolkit cost minimum. It does not establish uniqueness of a true-moment optimum profile.
result.true_cost_scope: Pinned toolkit T_r includes its per-child fallback overhead; this is not the global kappa-root equation. Interval excludes the unchanged centre descents.

statistics.order_stream: SHA256(experiment, seed, immutable word identifiers, order index), independent of batching
statistics.potential_proof: Sum of mutable frame dimensions is a nonnegative integer and strictly decreases at every accepted lowering; this proves termination only.
statistics.scope: Profile agreement to a certified integer-surrogate reference at one endpoint. A true-minimum interval does not prove a unique exact-moment optimum profile; no state-confluence or abelianity theorem.
statistics.terminal_maximality: Final full sweep tests every legal proper-subspace single-gate lowering using rational cost intervals.
